# CANDIDATE: BEARISH_REJECTION_PREMIUM_STOP_30PCT

**Filed:** 2026-07-12  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Tightening the premium stop from -50% to -30% will reduce catastrophic losses on losing trades, increasing win rate and reducing average loss magnitude. However, it may also prematurely exit winning trades that experience temporary drawdowns, reducing average gain per trade. Net effect on edge_capture is uncertain without OOS validation.

## Mechanism

Change the premium stop parameter for BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON in Safe account from `-0.50` to `-0.30`. Chart stop (primary invalidation) and chandelier profit-lock remain unchanged. Position sizing and all other parameters (TP1, runner, etc.) stay identical to baseline.
